description: This source file defines the CLIInstallPrompter class, which manages prompting the user to install the CLI tool, handling the installation process, and opening settings within a macOS app. It includes methods for checking whether to prompt, performing the prompt, and executing the installation, utilizing AppKit for UI alerts and interacting with application settings.

classes.name: CLIInstallPrompter
classes.description: A singleton class responsible for prompting the user to install the CLI, checking conditions for prompting, executing the installation, and opening settings as needed.

classes.name: StatusBox
classes.description: An actor class used internally for managing the status message during CLI installation.

methods.name: checkAndPromptIfNeeded
methods.description: Checks whether user prompting is needed based on app state and versions, then displays an alert to the user with options to install CLI, not prompt now, or open settings.

methods.name: shouldPrompt
methods.description: Determines whether the prompt should be shown based on various conditions such as onboarding status, connection mode, installation status, and prior prompts.

methods.name: installCLI
methods.description: Performs the asynchronous installation of the CLI and presents a status alert upon completion.

methods.name: openSettings
methods.description: Opens the app settings window and posts a notification to select a specific settings tab.

methods.name: appVersion
methods.description: Retrieves the app's version string from the bundle's info dictionary.
